resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Formal incompleteness explains why no sufficiently expressive effective theory captures all arithmetic truth, but it does not by itself provide a structural language for comparing theory growth. This paper develops such a language by treating a formal theory as a packaged closure object evaluated on a frozen ledger. First, a fixed idempotent package saturates under iteration: repeated closure does not sustain persistent strict growth. Hence genuine growth requires package change. Second, on a frozen slice with fixed yield, cost, and support data, efficiency transfers across cone-equivalent representatives, yielding a restricted alignment theorem. Third, these internal results combine with an explicit external dependency contract to give a conditional arithmetic lift: if the required canonical-family-on-cone assumptions are discharged from the arithmetic literature, then frontier-efficient extension operators admit canonical representatives on the relevant comparison cone. The result reframes incompleteness and axiom choice in package language. G\"odel becomes the canonical fixed-package failure mode, while new axioms appear as controlled package changes evaluated under a frozen regime. Vendor-backed PICA evidence is used only to discipline primitive roles and scope, not as proof support.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: Next-token prediction is not, by itself, a theory of compositional content: finite predictive statistics can agree while the induced quotients compose differently under larger contexts. We study an alternative, non-gradient formulation in which a language model is an audited ledger of finite theory extensions rather than a parameter vector. Six Birds Theory (SBT) supplies the admissibility calculus: typed closure-package layers, explicit quotient maps, audit records, nonclaim records, and promotion gates based on descent, stability, control, no-smuggling, legibility, and strict factorization failure. We introduce Language Theory Models (LTMs), a prototype architecture for structural recovery on fixed sequence corpora. An LTM accumulates typed transition evidence, monitors each active layer with a conditional-information closure-deficit statistic and an idempotence/self-consistency defect, and proposes new layers only when the current quotient leaves recoverable structure unresolved. Candidate layers are committed only after an explicit gate panel emits a strict-extension certificate; otherwise the runtime records a typed defect or remains silent rather than laundering fallback evidence into a stronger claim. We report a code-backed feasibility study on Shakespeare: the runtime builds closure-package layers, records promotion attempts and failures, emits halt verdicts, caps unaudited fallback readout, and demonstrates strict R-layer growth in bounded runs. Independent of the LTM runtime, we provide a structural probe suite that tests SBT framework-level commitments under blue-team and red-team cases, including growth, forgetting, uncertainty, auditability, and concept-separation scenarios. The contribution is a concrete audited substrate for testing whether compositional structure in a fixed corpus can be recovered as a finite ladder of certified theory refinements.

resolved_source_locations.conclusion: The most direct next construction is a within-agent learning or acquisition carrier, in which the individual agent is treated as a carrier object in the sense of the Six Birds treatment of agency . The failed crystallization bridge in shows that experience-as-composition selection makes the finite carrier more homogeneous and more stage-predictable, whereas the data show history-dependence growing with experience. A carrier in which individual agents acquire conditional rules over their own histories would test the mechanism that this contrast leaves open. A second direction is a broader family of noisy and dissipative carriers, to map route memory beyond the tested noise grid and to learn when currentizable traces become genuinely coherent. A third is to enlarge the strategic and payoff substrate: richer automata, larger action spaces, asymmetric games, and longer public signals would test which carrier facts persist and which are artifacts of the minimal catalog. The run layer also invites a bounded-rationality connection. The imitation dynamics used here contain a logit-style temperature parameter; in a maximum-entropy or shadow-price reading, such a parameter can be interpreted as the dual of a binding cognitive or informational budget rather than a free behavioral knob . That connection is only an opening in this paper, but it suggests how run-only constants might be tied to explicit resource constraints. On the empirical side, the immediate extension is broader pre-registered testing of the residue hypothesis and the timing reversal on other repeated-game datasets, with the same discipline: hypotheses, predictors, bands, folds, and amendments fixed before outcome analysis.
